clauses.why: A size limit turns people away, against the request's purpose; an unbounded waitlist delivers what was asked.
A per-member cap on concurrent waitlists is an added restriction the request's purpose does not need.
Staff removal of waitlist entries is an added management capability; the waitlist works without it.
Staff closing and reopening joining per class is an added control the request does not call for.
An operator kill switch for the feature is added operational capability beyond the waitlist asked for.
Guaranteeing behaviour after reverting to an older version is a deployment duty the request does not call for.
A penalty-free cancellation window is a new pricing policy beyond adding a waitlist.
A per-entry event history for staff is an added audit capability not needed for the waitlist to work.
Retention rule exists only because the spec introduced the staff history of C-45.
Validation of a staff-set size limit arises only from the spec's own added limit setting (C-87).
Notifying waitlisted members of start-time changes is an added duty beyond the requested waitlist.
This race arises only from the spec's added staff-removal capability (C-25).
Behaviour while the feature is switched off arises only from the spec's added kill switch (C-29).
Display while switched off arises only from the spec's added kill switch (C-29).
Arises only from the spec's added staff-removal capability (C-25).
Encrypted transport is true of any hosted product, including the existing app; it decides nothing specific to the waitlist.
Anonymising history arises only from the spec's added staff history (C-45).
An hourly join-rate limit is an added restriction the request's purpose does not need.
Per-class staff-set size limits are an added management capability; the waitlist works without them.
Behaviour of freed spots while switched off arises only from the spec's added kill switch (C-29).
Resuming promotions after switch-on arises only from the spec's added kill switch (C-29).
Re-introduction after a revert arises only from the spec's added rollback duty (C-32).
Mirroring every notice in the app is an added capability beyond notifying members.
Retention of in-app notice information arises only from the spec's added in-app mirror (C-91).
